scope.restriction: UI/stream/history/privacy-client review only; no real account, model, external endpoint, deployment or load test.
scope.baselineIntegrity: Browser render comparison reads the fixed Sites commit with git --no-replace-objects show.

findings.title: Every streamed prefix invalidated all historical assistant replies through context
findings.trigger: Open a conversation with historical assistant replies while a new answer is revealed. AssistantReply subscribed directly to the entire store, whose value changes on each prefix.
findings.impact: Context bypassed memoized MessageRow and reparsed every historical RichText block and provenance list up to 50 times/second.
findings.fix: MessageList reads words once and passes its stable map through memoized MessageRow to AssistantReply. Vocabulary replacement still invalidates provenance.

evidence.fixture: Actual production React DOM, MessageList, RichText and AiProvenance; 120 messages, including 59 historical assistant replies and one active reply; 20 prefix updates spaced 20 ms apart; three independent rounds per variant.
evidence.measuredScope: Controlled component fixture; timings exclude app startup, layout/CSS realism, persistence, network and provider latency. Not INP or a whole-app benchmark.

securityReview.evidence: requestCompanion checks account scope, context revision/version, epoch and local practice generation before/after reads and final context refresh; provider also fences progress/reveal by current scope, generation and request message ID.

Temporary conversations are excluded from serialization; global temporary mode resets identity and cancels pending work. Conversation deletion and identity reset abort readers/reveal and remove request IDs, preventing late resurrection.

Abort cancels a stalled stream reader. Parser limits SSE bytes to 256000 and non-comment frames to 64; validates phase allowlist. Reader lock, listeners and request timeout are released in finally. Reveal is grapheme-safe, capped at five seconds and respects reduced motion.

securityReview.area: History checkpoints and untrusted stored data
securityReview.evidence: Checkpoint reads current state inside the local write lock and checks scope/sequence/generation. CAS mismatch synchronizes instead of overwriting. Stored history is projected to 50 conversations, 120 messages each and 1000000 characters; raw attachments, drafts, hidden suffixes and transient progress are omitted.

Answer and summary use React text nodes, without HTML injection. Summary is bounded to 6000 characters and answer to 30000. Saved provenance is projected to unverified/model-generated metadata; visible entry locations come from the current formally released vocabulary.

securityReview.result: No new blocker found in client scope
securityReview.evidence: Reading skips personal- article logging. Voice, discussion and dictation callers send generic titles and counts; recordLearningActivity rejects private reading and projects facts before queuing. Account/temporary generation fences remain. Server enforcement and migrations belong to the separate review.

Full and mini views preserve upward scrolling, expose a jump-to-latest control and reset stickiness on conversation change. Reduced-motion and forced-color fallbacks remain; no HTML interpretation was added.

verification.executionNote: Confirmed with normal child-process permissions. The sandbox-only attempt reported seven file wrappers and was not used as case-count evidence.

verification.assertions: 59 historical reply skips during every prefix; active text updated; new vocabulary invalidates all historical source locations; no browser exceptions; 120 message fixture preserved.

limits: This scoped review does not certify backend authorization, model-provider behavior, migrations, packaged worker behavior or deployment.
The existing full-app browser-performance fixture seeds only user messages; include historical assistant replies and a phased answer in final app-level performance coverage.

Whole-app privacy races, mobile layout and full security/performance suites are handled by the parent final verification; this pass ran the focused actual-component regression and companion unit tests.

The final whole-app mixed-history load test is blocked by managed-preview startup EPERM; mixed-ui-load.json records blocked_environment with no runs. Component Chromium results do not replace whole-app verification.
